name: bundle-builder
title: Bundle Builder
description: Three or four product tiles drop one by one into an open box while the total counts up, then a "Hemat" badge lands on the box and the total steps down to the bundle price. Products, prices and the saving are variables.
useWhen: Selling a bundle or package (paket hemat, hampers, combo) at a lower price than the items alone.
A shop wants to show what is inside a set and what it saves.
avoidWhen: One product with an old and new price: use price-drop.
A countdown to a limited sale: use fomo-limit-orders.
author: Mosio

source.technique: stagger and count-up: items dropping in one at a time, ending on a stamped badge

variables.label: Box title
variables.description: Printed on the front of the box.

variables.label: Products
variables.description: Three or four products separated by semicolons, each as name|price.

variables.label: Total label
variables.description: Small label above the running total.

variables.label: Saving
variables.description: Amount saved by buying the bundle. The total steps down by this at the end. Use 0 or leave empty for no saving.

variables.label: Saving label
variables.description: Word in front of the saving amount on the badge.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: The saving badge: the one accent.

variables.label: Font
variables.description: Font family name. Geist is loaded by default; another family must be loaded by the host.

variables.label: Transparent
variables.description: Leave the background clear so the block sits over your own scene.
